questions.title: Real numbers
questions.content: Which of the following is **not** a real number?
questions.explanation:
The square root of a negative number is not real; it is imaginary.
$\sqrt{-9} = 3i$, so option C is not a real number.
All the other options are rational or irrational numbers, which are real.

questions.title: Rationalising the denominator
questions.content:
Which of the following is the rationalised form of the expression below?

$$\frac{5}{2 + \sqrt{3}}$$
questions.explanation:
Multiply the top and bottom by the conjugate $2 - \sqrt{3}$:
$$\frac{5}{2 + \sqrt{3}} \times \frac{2 - \sqrt{3}}{2 - \sqrt{3}} = \frac{5(2 - \sqrt{3})}{4 - 3} = 10 - 5\sqrt{3}$$
**Common mistake:** adding instead of subtracting in the denominator gives $4 + 3 = 7$.

questions.title: Moles of water
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.content:
How many moles of water are produced when 4 mol of $H_2$ react completely with excess $O_2$?

$$2H_2 + O_2 \rightarrow 2H_2O$$
questions.explanation: The ratio of $H_2$ to $H_2O$ is 2 : 2, so 4 mol of $H_2$ gives 4 mol of $H_2O$.
